description: Canonical registry of conformance vector identifiers. Every ak.vector.* identifier referenced by prose or fixtures MUST appear here, and every row MUST point at the prose or fixture source that defines it.

vectors.description: Reducer normalizes Realm/deployment native_agent wrappers against flat Circle/Strand participation bits before tighten-only comparison; structural mismatch never skips enforcement.

Applet transaction push source signature anchor: per-delivery RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature covering method/target/authority/content-digest/source-service-id/destination-service-id/idempotency-key, source_signature_anchor persisted into the idempotency/replay record, duplicate body/anchor conflicts fail closed, and source service authentication does not replace Event actor/applet/capability checks.

Deterministic Applet registration_epoch recomputation from the closed normalized transcript, UTF-8 domain separator, JCS bytes, and SHA-256; covers set sorting and duplicate rejection, optional omission, DID method version evidence, and security-field rotation.
field_access.sensitive_fields read projection handling: redact/hash/omit remove original values, hash uses keyed/salted digest discipline, and unenforceable handling falls back to omit.

Streaming chunked AEAD (ak.blob.stream_aead.v1) happy path: multi-segment plaintext with a short final segment is split, per-segment AEAD encrypted, segment-wise downloaded and incrementally verified, and the top-level ciphertext_digest is recomputed and matches per media-and-blob.md section 3.3.

Streaming AEAD truncation: a dropped final segment, a last segment whose flag stays 0x00, or segment_count exhausted without last_segment_flag=0x01 MUST be rejected with segment_stream_truncated and buffered plaintext discarded.
Streaming AEAD ordering: out-of-order / skipped / gapped segment_index MUST be rejected with segment_sequence_invalid; a repeated segment_index MUST be rejected with segment_replay.

Streaming AEAD scheme closure: an unknown attachment scheme MUST fail closed with unsupported_attachment_scheme (no fallback decrypt); an envelope carrying both whole-file nonce and chunked nonce_prefix/segment_* fields MUST fail blob.schema.json encrypted_attachment oneOf validation.

Streaming AEAD declared-bounds negatives (declared fields only, no multi-MiB payload materialised): segment_count above 2^20, segment_size below 1 KiB or above 8 MiB, and segment_count inconsistent with ceil(size_bytes / segment_size) MUST all be rejected fail-closed (schema_violation, reason_code segment_bounds_invalid) before key derivation or any segment download.

Realm create is atomically paired with one immediately following closed-form self founding grant for created_by; missing, widened, third-party, reordered, or post-bootstrap replayed founding grants fail closed without leaving a partial Realm or membership.

Hard quota counters use one logical linearizable authority across every service node: a race for the last slot cannot overshoot, idempotent retries count once, unavailable authority fails closed, and calendar-month periods are rejected.

Temporal action gates are neutral for unrelated actions according to effect, while edit/redact windows use the verified target created_at and the fixed verification time/skew to accept inside the deadline and fail closed outside or on missing target time.
Accepts the three legal first call states and rejects active or terminal first states.
Covers every legal call lifecycle transition and representative non-terminal illegal transitions.
Terminal call states reject every attempted outgoing transition with call_state_terminal.
Same-basis replay of the same from/to transition is idempotent and does not create a divergent head.
Same-basis sibling transitions to different states return fsm bottom instead of selecting a winner.

Recording retention: audit_lock blocks deletion (legal_hold_active) regardless of retention_expires_at, and entering a capturing recording_state without consent_confirmed fails with recording_consent_required.

Recording ready results MUST carry ak.schema.call_recording_artifact.v1 metadata bound to the recording start event, Arkret blob pipeline, recording exporter label/context, retention policy, deletion audit trigger, and erasure receipt.

Transcription requires ak.call.transcribe (transcription_denied otherwise), and transcript artifacts MUST use the ak.rtc-transcript-key/v1 exporter label with a dedicated Context (transcription_artifact_pipeline_bypassed otherwise).
Moderator kick/ban requires ak.call.moderate (call_moderation_unauthorised otherwise); removed_participants[] gates token re-issue with call_participant_removed.

P2P calls converge to SFU when participants exceed two, reusing the oldest_membership no-vote session_focus election; mode does not auto-downgrade, and ak.call.summary is gated on a terminal call state (call_summary_invalid otherwise).
resolve_agent_selector failure branches for missing, hidden, and unauthorized selectors return the same status, body shape, error class, and timing bucket.
resolve_handle failure branches for missing, hidden, and unauthorized handles return the same status, body shape, error class, and timing bucket.
on_last_read converges by principal-level aggregate contributions and read_trigger_window_ms; offline devices receive expiry stubs and shred keys when they reconnect.
Read-trigger expiry anchors are derived from anonymous aggregate contributions and MUST NOT reveal reader identity or reader counts to other clients or services outside the aggregate boundary.
Duplicate, stale, out-of-order, or cross-bound read-trigger contributions MUST NOT refresh anchors, double-count readers, or expire the wrong message.

Opposite delivery orders at two aggregate services converge through per-token and aggregate min joins; a late earlier valid contribution can only move expiry earlier and can never restore shredded content.
BLAKE3 KAT over fixed UTF-8 bytes plus wrong-prefix, wrong-length, Realm-suite mismatch, and unknown-suite downgrade rejection cases.
ECDSA P-256 (ES256, RFC 6979 deterministic) detached JWS golden vector over the canonical proof binding object, mirroring the ed25519 vector structure for the optional interop signature suite.

ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) raw detached signature golden vector over the canonical proof binding object bytes (registry proof_kind raw_detached_signature; keygen from a recorded xi seed, signature published as a recorded value that verifiers only verify).

Executable signature negative family for Ed25519, ES256, and ML-DSA-65: bad or truncated signatures, alg/key-type mismatch, malformed algorithm-specific public keys, and detached-profile confusion; every case MUST be rejected with the recorded error_code.

Hand-written deterministic CBOR bounds: a definite-length array declaring/carrying 65537 items (generator-described, built by the runner) exceeds the v1 cap of 65536 items per array/map and MUST be rejected (reason_code cbor_bounds_invalid) without preallocating from the declared count.

CBOR indefinite-length item (raw bytes bf616101ff, the indefinite-length map {_ "a": 1}) violates RFC 8949 section 4.2 deterministic encoding and MUST be rejected (reason_code cbor_not_deterministic); locks the SDK's existing indefinite-length rejection on the mls_governance_binding decode path.

CBOR capacity bomb: a byte string header declaring 4294967295 bytes with only 4 bytes of remaining input (raw bytes 5affffffffdeadbeef) MUST be rejected (reason_code cbor_bounds_invalid) before any buffer is allocated from the declared length.

Canonical structure depth cap: a JSON object nested 65 levels deep (generator-described, built by the runner; top-level container = depth 1) exceeds the v1 maximum nesting depth of 64 (objects and arrays combined) and MUST be rejected (reason_code structure_depth_exceeded) with bounded recursion; a depth-64 control input MUST be accepted.

Federation ingress authentication-failure family (unknown peer / not authorized / target absent) returns indistinguishable responses within one timing bucket per relation.md section 4.5 sampling rules.

service_binding_ref.reducer_profile_digest is computed per federation.md section 4.1.1 from the reducer-profile-registry.json digest_input row (Arkret canonical JSON, sha256); receiver recomputes and byte-compares, rejecting the whole batch with reducer_profile_mismatch on any divergence.

RFC 9180 base-mode byte-level KAT for ak.hpke_x25519_aead_chacha20poly1305.v1 (DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) / HKDF-SHA256 / ChaCha20-Poly1305): DeriveKeyPair, encap, key-schedule intermediates, seq-0/1 ciphertexts and export values MUST reproduce byte-for-byte.

RFC 9180 base-mode byte-level KAT for ak.hpke_x25519_aead_aes256gcm.v1 (DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) / HKDF-SHA256 / AES-256-GCM): DeriveKeyPair, encap, key-schedule intermediates, seq-0/1 ciphertexts and export values MUST reproduce byte-for-byte.

RFC 9180 base-mode byte-level KAT for ak.hpke_p256_aead_aes256gcm.v1 (DHKEM(P-256, HKDF-SHA256) / HKDF-SHA256 / AES-256-GCM, profile-gated interop suite): DeriveKeyPair, encap, key-schedule intermediates, seq-0/1 ciphertexts and export values MUST reproduce byte-for-byte.
Handle issuer/registry rejects mixed-script U-labels, UTS#39 skeleton collisions, and hyphen-disallowed-position inputs before IDNA conversion.
Realm alias registry applies the same mixed-script, confusable-skeleton, and hyphen-position rejection discipline as handles.

Realm reducer authority for ak.invite.claim: binding_proof and subject_proof signature transcripts, token_commitment match, verification_service_id allowlist re-check, claim_nonce replay rejection, pending -> claimed membership-proposal conversion, and expiry cleanup are enforced before acceptance.

New passphrase_kdf backup envelopes below the unconditional base KDF floor (Argon2id memory_kib>=65536 / iterations>=3 / parallelism>=1; PBKDF2 iterations>=600000 with allowed digest_algorithm) MUST be rejected.
Key backup retrieval requires a session-bound unlock proof (ak.schema.key_backup_unlock_proof.v1); any binding mismatch or bearer-token-only access fails closed before ciphertext is returned.

Last-resort KeyPackage (ak.feature.mls_last_resort_keypackage.v1): when the normal pool is empty, claim MAY return last_resort=true; the package is reused across multiple Welcomes within the same intended_realm_id, consume is idempotent (stays published, never keypackage_already_consumed), and each consumption emits an append-only audit record per encryption-and-audit.md section 2.6.2.

Last-resort KeyPackage forced rotation: on next online the holder MUST rotate the last-resort package (new init key, old marked rotated) and trigger an MLS self-update Commit on every group joined via it to advance the epoch and close the forward-secrecy weakening window.

Last-resort KeyPackage Realm affinity, optionality, and profile gating: cross-intended_realm_id reuse MUST be rejected with last_resort_realm_affinity_violation; a server not declaring the feature MUST fail closed on an empty pool and MUST NOT return a last_resort package, with explicit last-resort fallback returning last_resort_not_supported; high_security_organization and sovereign_deployment Realms MUST treat last-resort as forbidden even when the service supports the feature.
MIMI Provider Facade directory claims are accepted only when the Arkret profile and pinned MIMI Internet-Draft versions match.
ak.mimi.room_binding projects a MIMI room onto a Realm or Strand scope without making the MIMI room canonical truth.
MIMI key-material exchange maps to the Arkret KeyPackage claim lifecycle: the claimed package is single-use, becomes consumed after Welcome, and enumeration-sensitive failures share one public shape.
MIMI message/content ingress preserves the original envelope digest and MIMI message identity when mapping into Arkret events.
MIMI identifier queries use private-contact-discovery semantics and do not expose a raw contact graph or reachability proof.
MIMI consent state is isolated from Arkret Realm read/write capability grants.
MIMI proxy download obeys asset privacy policy and does not return direct object-store URLs when provider proxying is required.
Unsupported MIMI draft versions fail closed or require a new profile without silently mutating the v1 reducer profile.

Byte-level KAT for MLS ciphersuite 0x0001, pinned to the MLS WG vector corpus commit recorded in mls-ciphersuite-registry.json. Reserved until an in-tree machine fixture (spec/v1/artifacts/fixtures/) carries the executable KAT evidence; the strict certification gate rejects active doc-only rows.

Appeal verdict transitions are atomic: overturn requires a same-batch ak.moderation.decision.lift and never resurrects irreversible redaction/key-destruction effects; modify requires both a same-batch lift of the original decision and the replacement decision matched by modify_decision_ref.

E2EE franking proof construction, report submission, and moderator-side verification roundtrip per content-moderation.md section 3.4; digest mismatch or minimal-disclosure violations downgrade or reject the proof.

Multiple active moderation decisions use the deterministic strictest fold instead of being mislabeled as split; require_review is carried by the active decision add and resolution atomically lifts every applicable review gate before current authz is re-evaluated or a stricter replacement is added.

E2EE moderation evidence packages are encrypted to the authorized moderation recipient, target only reported events, carry reporter signature evidence, and reject MLS epoch/history secrets or unrelated plaintext.
Deterministic identity migration preserves every Morph field and canonical JSON value.

Deterministic ak.morph.schema_migrate transformation: a ak.transform.rename.v1 rule renames a Morph field and leaves unrelated fields untouched; the post-migration fields projection is canonical-JSON byte-equal across replays.

Deterministic ak.morph.schema_migrate transformation: a ak.transform.default_backfill.v1 rule backfills a new optional field with a fixed default while preserving existing fields; idempotent and replay-deterministic.
Deterministic integer-to-number schema widening preserves the JSON numeric value and rejects unregistered widening pairs.
Seal canonical bytes exclude id and notary_signature; verifier recomputes the typed id and signature payload digest from signed top-level fields only.
cas_register writes on non-initial state require an explicit CBA basis: Control Move preconditions or equivalent DataEvent causal/lattice proof; null-basis blind overwrites fail closed.
open_set concurrent revocation is evaluated against the joined control view; revoked or bottom authorization cells fail closed without a freshness window.
bottom=reject control cell recovery accepts only a sealed conflict-recovery Move with valid recovery_capability and pre-conflict state_witness; negative cases pin recovery_witness_* reasons.
Expired policy decisions and decisions bound to an older auth/policy/membership frontier MUST be rejected on replay; receivers fail closed and re-request the policy check.
Receivers recompute the RFC 8785 JCS request_canonical_digest of the presented request body; mismatch with the signed bound_to transcript MUST reject the decision.

Sender-constrained session PoP: a write request with a valid RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature (kid = current grant session_public_key, covering @method/@target-uri/@authority/content-digest) is accepted; a signature whose transcript mismatches the method/path/body digest fails verification and is rejected per api-conventions.md section 3.2 and service-http-binding.md section 2.5.

Production current-v1 protected endpoints MUST reject bare Authorization: Bearer unless it is bound by DPoP, an RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature, detached JWS, mTLS, or equivalent sender-constrained proof; high-security profiles additionally require RFC 9421 PoP for regular writes / sensitive reads; a PoP signature whose created/expires falls outside the replay window MUST be rejected.

DPoP htu binds scheme, authority, and path: cross-authority/scheme reuse, untrusted forwarding headers, and missing authority are rejected; only a configured trusted proxy with scrubbed headers may reconstruct the external URI.
A DPoP/RFC 9421 grant-binding session key must not reuse bytes, fingerprints, thumbprints, or key identifiers from the long-term device identity key; reuse fails closed.

High-assurance snapshot inclusion-challenge sampling verifies sufficient event_id and actor_seq_range coverage, recomputes the event-set Merkle root, rejects commitment-root mismatch, and rejects silent actor sequence gaps.

Client events.query backfill with include_completeness=true detects withheld actor branches via ak.attestation.range_completeness verification; feature-less servers ignore the parameter; single_source attestation does not satisfy high-assurance realms.
Canonical JSON object key ordering follows UTF-16 code units for supplementary-plane keys.
Blind-index stale postings after revocation, visibility tightening, redaction, expiry, or epoch rotation MUST not produce unauthorized recall.
Search hit is not an authorization proof; unauthorized or unverifiable hits return non-enumerating stubs.
Directory search, privacy-preserving search, and bridge interop surfaces stay separated and do not leak private plaintext.
Receiver rejects sender_nonce_prefix collision or nonce prefix mismatch.
Receiver rejects repeated per-device AEAD nonce counter.
Receiver rejects pure random 96-bit nonce profile for v1 encrypted attachments.
mv_register join/validate_op convergence for the same CBA Event set.
counter join/validate_op convergence for the same CBA Event set.
ordered_log join/validate_op convergence for the same CBA Event set.
fsm join: identical (from,to) sibling transitions converge idempotently; same-from different-to siblings return bottom (reject path).
ordered_log issuer sub-chain seq gap yields contiguous_prefix plus pending_gap diagnostics; deterministic recompute after backfill.
directory_visibility=realm_members exposes only the Realm-member preview field set and gives non-Realm callers the same locked stub/timing bucket as members-only circles.
RSVP occurrence key canonicalizes recurrence instance local wall-clock start in the event timezone.

Realm Link FSM: all declared initial states and transitions are accepted, tombstoned is terminal except byte-equivalent replay, undeclared transitions reject with realm_link_invalid_transition, same-basis divergent siblings return bottom, general graph cycles remain valid, and self-reference rejects with realm_link_self_reference.

minimal-metadata and audited E2EE Realms force mention_routing_hint=disabled even when policy declares recipient_registered_token; no sidecar registration, comparison, or persistence occurs and delivery falls back to blind or batch wakeup.

Account and events NDJSON stream trace conformance: catchup completion ordering, cursor-bearing frame closure, dropped-versus-resync branching, and reconnect position advancement are evaluated over complete traces rather than isolated frame schemas.

High-risk agent session scope returns claim_required with closed details {reason_code=human_approval_required, approval_request_id}; controller approval is out of band and CAPTCHA, OTP, password, and browser challenges are forbidden on the runtime path.

Minimal-metadata author verification binds Event.actor_id and proof.verification_method to exactly one active MLS basic credential / LeafNode signature_key at the envelope epoch, rejects rollback/removal/duplicate/key-mismatch cases, and forbids principal-scoped keys/query fallback.
